sources.label: Official lululemon UK size guide (Women's Tops + Bottoms, US 0–20, cm, location United Kingdom)

audit: Old URL /en-gb/size-guide is blank; guide moved. Official tops chart (US 0–20) gives chest only, as cm values/ranges; waist and hip come from the bottoms chart on the same page for the same US sizes. Size 6 bust 86→83.8–86.4, waist 66→66–68.6, hips 91→91.4–94; size 12 bust 99→101.6, hips 104→109.2. Extended from US 16 to US 20. UK/EU are the tops-chart conversions exactly as published (US 6 = UK 10–12, US 8 = UK 12–14, US 10 = UK 14; EU 26–54); the bottoms chart's UK/EU conversions differ and are not mixed in. The page's internal tab id says 'asia-fit', but it is the only women's chart the UK site shows (titled 'Women's Tops Size Guide').
notes: Canadian premium activewear brand. Designed in US sizes; lululemon's own UK conversion puts US 8 at UK 12–14 and US 6 at UK 10–12. Four-way stretch fabrics are very body-conscious. Align leggings are the most size-critical item.
